plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai instructions replayed an outdated positional selector (#nav > ... > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) that now targets the 'Solutions' dropdown instead of 'Developers', causing navigation to the wrong page.
observedIndicators: Error: expect(received).toEqual(expected) failed with expected 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/' but received 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/'.
Tool history and page_ai_cache show cached selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button' clicked the 'Solutions' button instead of 'Developers'.
Failure screenshot shows the live navigation bar has 'Solutions' at position 2 and 'Developers' at position 3.
History shows prior deterministic runs oscillating between pass and fail depending on cache state.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai deterministic cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the page.ai cache for checkly.test.ts and re-run the flow so the agent re-indexes the Developers menu item and Documentation link on the current navigation bar layout.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai deterministic cache will allow the autonomous agent to re-evaluate the page and correctly select the Developers menu and Documentation link.
